passages.text: “Now these are the names of the tribes: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion bordering the road of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath and running on to Hazar-enan on the border of Damascus with Hamath to the north, and extending from the east side to the west side.
passages.sermon:
These are the names of the tribes of Israel.
Dan is one of the tribes.
Dan will receive one portion of land.
This portion is at the northern border of Israel.
The land will border the road of Hethlon.
It will reach to Lebo-hamath.
It will continue to Hazar-enan.
Hazar-enan is on the border of Damascus.
The land will also border Hamath to the north.
Dan’s portion will stretch from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִקְצֵ֣ה צָפ֡וֹנָה אֶל־ יַ֣ד דֶּֽרֶךְ־ חֶתְלֹ֣ן׀ לְֽבוֹא־ חֲמָ֡ת חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָן֩ גְּב֨וּל דַּמֶּ֤שֶׂק צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ אֶל־ יַ֣ד חֲמָ֔ת וְהָיוּ־ ל֧וֹ פְאַת־ קָדִ֛ים הַיָּ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Asher will have one portion bordering the territory of Dan from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Asher is a tribe of Israel.
Asher will receive one portion of land.
This land will border the territory of Dan.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל דָּ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה אָשֵׁ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Naphtali will have one portion bordering the territory of Asher from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Naphtali is a tribe of Israel.
Naphtali will receive one portion of land.
This land will border the territory of Asher.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל אָשֵׁ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה וְעַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה נַפְתָּלִ֥י אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Manasseh will have one portion bordering the territory of Naphtali from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Manasseh is a tribe of Israel.
Manasseh will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Naphtali.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל נַפְתָּלִ֗י מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Ephraim will have one portion bordering the territory of Manasseh from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim is a tribe of Israel.
Ephraim will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Manasseh.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Reuben will have one portion bordering the territory of Ephraim from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Reuben is a tribe of Israel.
Reuben will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Ephraim.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל אֶפְרַ֗יִם מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים וְעַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה רְאוּבֵ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Judah will have one portion bordering the territory of Reuben from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Judah is a tribe of Israel.
Judah will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Reuben.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל רְאוּבֵ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה יְהוּדָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Bordering the territory of Judah, from east to west, will be the portion you are to set apart. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and the length of a tribal portion from east to west. In the center will be the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
The passage describes land near Judah’s territory.
Judah is a tribe of Israel.
The land runs from the east side to the west side.
You must set apart a special portion of land.
This portion will be 25,000 cubits wide.
The length will be the same as a tribal portion from east to west.
The sanctuary will stand in the center of this portion.
passages.original: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֖ים עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֑מָּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ תָּרִ֡ימוּ חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֹ֗חַב וְאֹ֜רֶךְ כְּאַחַ֤ד הַחֲלָקִים֙ מִפְּאַ֤ת קָדִ֙ימָה֙ עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The special portion you set apart to the LORD shall be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
The LORD commands you to set apart a special portion.
This portion is for the LORD.
The length of this portion is 25,000 cubits.
The width of this portion is 10,000 cubits.
passages.original: הַתְּרוּמָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּרִ֖ימוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃

passages.text: This will be the holy portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side, and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center will be the sanctuary of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave a special portion of land to the priests.
This portion is holy.
The north side of this land is 25,000 cubits long.
The south side is also 25,000 cubits long.
The west side is 10,000 cubits wide.
The east side is 10,000 cubits wide.
The sanctuary of the LORD stands in the center of this land.
passages.original: וּ֠לְאֵ֜לֶּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה תְרֽוּמַת־ הַקֹּדֶשׁ֮ לַכֹּֽהֲנִים֒ צָפ֜וֹנָה חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֗לֶף וְיָ֙מָּה֙ רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְקָדִ֗ימָה רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְנֶ֕גְבָּה אֹ֕רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וְהָיָ֥ה מִקְדַּשׁ־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃

passages.text: It will be for the consecrated priests, the descendants of Zadok, who kept My charge and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about a special portion of land.
This portion is for the priests.
These priests are consecrated.
They are descendants of Zadok.
These priests kept the LORD’s charge.
They did not go astray.
The Levites went astray when the Israelites went astray.
The descendants of Zadok did not go astray like the Levites.
passages.original: לַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽמְקֻדָּשׁ֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י צָד֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ תָע֗וּ בִּתְעוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ס

passages.text: It will be a special portion for them set apart from the land, a most holy portion adjacent to the territory of the Levites.
passages.sermon:
God gave a special portion to the priests.
This portion comes from the land.
God set this portion apart as most holy.
This holy portion lies next to the territory of the Levites.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם תְּרוּמִיָּ֛ה מִתְּרוּמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־ גְּב֖וּל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: Bordering the territory of the priests, the Levites shall have an area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. The whole length will be 25,000 cubits, and the width 10,000 cubits.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a group set apart for service to God.
They will receive land next to the priests’ territory.
Their area will be 25,000 cubits long.
Their area will be 10,000 cubits wide.
The total length of their land will be 25,000 cubits.
The total width will be 10,000 cubits.
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם לְעֻמַּת֙ גְּב֣וּל הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים כָּל־ אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃

passages.text: They must not sell or exchange any of it, and they must not transfer this best part of the land, for it is holy to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
This land is the best part of the land.
This land is holy to the LORD.
They must not sell any of it.
They must not exchange any of it.
They must not transfer any of it.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יִמְכְּר֣וּ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹ֥א יָמֵ֛ר וְלֹ֥א יַעֲבוּר רֵאשִׁ֣ית הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּי־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for common use by the city, for houses, and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it and will have these measurements: 4,500 cubits on the north side, 4,500 cubits on the south side, 4,500 cubits on the east side, and 4,500 cubits on the west side.
passages.sermon:
God gave land to the people of Israel.
He set aside a special area for the city.
This area is 5,000 cubits wide.
It is 25,000 cubits long.
People will use this land for the city.
They will build houses there.
They will keep pastureland there.
The city will stand in the center of this area.
The city will have clear measurements.
The north side of the city will be 4,500 cubits long.
The south side will also be 4,500 cubits long.
The east side will be 4,500 cubits long.
The west side will be 4,500 cubits long.
passages.original: וַחֲמֵ֨שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֜ים הַנּוֹתָ֣ר בָּרֹ֗חַב עַל־ פְּנֵ֨י חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף חֹֽל־ ה֣וּא לָעִ֔יר לְמוֹשָׁ֖ב וּלְמִגְרָ֑שׁ וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָעִ֖יר בְּתוֹכֹה׃ וְאֵלֶּה֮ מִדּוֹתֶיהָ֒ פְּאַ֣ת צָפ֗וֹן חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־ נֶ֕גֶב חֲמֵ֥שׁ חמש מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּמִפְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ים חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־ יָ֕מָּה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִֽים׃

passages.text: The pastureland of the city will extend 250 cubits to the north, 250 cubits to the south, 250 cubits to the east, and 250 cubits to the west.
passages.sermon:
The city will have pastureland around it.
The pastureland will extend 250 cubits to the north.
It will extend 250 cubits to the south.
It will extend 250 cubits to the east.
It will extend 250 cubits to the west.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה מִגְרָשׁ֮ לָעִיר֒ צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְנֶ֖גְבָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וְקָדִ֙ימָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְיָ֖מָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The remainder of the length bordering the holy portion and running adjacent to it will be 10,000 cubits on the east side and 10,000 cubits on the west side. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes land near the holy portion in the new city plan for Israel.
The land lies next to the holy portion.
It measures 10,000 cubits on the east side.
It also measures 10,000 cubits on the west side.
This land runs along the holy portion.
The land will produce crops.
The crops will provide food.
The food will go to the workers of the city.
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֨ר בָּאֹ֜רֶךְ לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים קָדִ֙ימָה֙ וַעֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֕ה לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהָיְתָ֤ה תְבוּאָתֹה לְלֶ֔חֶם לְעֹבְדֵ֖י הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: The workers of the city who cultivate it will come from all the tribes of Israel.
passages.sermon: The workers will serve the city.\r\nThey will cultivate the land.\r\nThese workers will come from every tribe of Israel.
passages.original: וְהָעֹבֵ֖ד הָעִ֑יר יַעַבְד֕וּהוּ מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits by 25,000 cubits. You are to set apart the holy portion, along with the city property.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for dividing the land of Israel.
The entire portion will be a square.
The square will measure 25,000 cubits on each side.
You must set apart the holy portion.
You must also set apart the property for the city.
You must do this within the square.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף רְבִיעִ֗ית תָּרִ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל־ אֲחֻזַּ֖ת הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: The remaining area on both sides of the holy portion and of the property of the city will belong to the prince. He will own the land adjacent to the tribal portions, extending eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the holy district toward the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. And in the center of them will be the holy portion and the sanctuary of the temple.
passages.sermon:
The prince will own the remaining land.
This land is on both sides of the holy portion and the city property.
The prince’s land will be next to the tribal portions.
It will stretch east from the 25,000 cubits of the holy district to the eastern border.
It will also stretch west from the 25,000 cubits to the western border.
The holy portion will be in the center of this land.
The sanctuary of the temple will also be in the center.
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֣ר לַנָּשִׂ֣יא מִזֶּ֣ה׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה׀ לִתְרֽוּמַת־ הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֪ת הָעִ֟יר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֥לֶף׀ תְּרוּמָה֮ עַד־ גְּב֣וּל קָדִימָה֒ וְיָ֗מָּה עַל־ פְּ֠נֵי חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ עַל־ גְּב֣וּל יָ֔מָּה לְעֻמַּ֥ת חֲלָקִ֖ים לַנָּשִׂ֑יא וְהָֽיְתָה֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ הַבַּ֖יִת בְּתוֹכֹה׃

passages.text: So the Levitical property and the city property will lie in the center of the area belonging to the prince—the area between the borders of Judah and Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
The Levitical property will be in the center of the prince’s land.
The city property will also be in the center of the prince’s land.
This area lies between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.
The prince will own this area.
passages.original: וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֤ת הַלְוִיִּם֙ וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר בְּת֛וֹךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִֽהְיֶ֑ה בֵּ֣ין׀ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבֵין֙ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion extending from the east side to the west side.
passages.sermon: The rest of the tribes receive their land next.\r\nBenjamin receives one portion.\r\nThis portion stretches from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְיֶ֖תֶר הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה בִּנְיָמִ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Simeon will have one portion bordering the territory of Benjamin from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Simeon is a tribe of Israel.
Simeon will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Benjamin.
The land will stretch from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה שִׁמְע֥וֹן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Issachar will have one portion bordering the territory of Simeon from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Issachar is one of the tribes of Israel.
Issachar will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Simeon.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל שִׁמְע֗וֹן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה יִשָׂשכָ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Zebulun will have one portion bordering the territory of Issachar from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Zebulun is a tribe of Israel.
Zebulun will receive one portion of land.
This land will border the territory of Issachar.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל יִשָׂשכָ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה זְבוּלֻ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: And Gad will have one portion bordering the territory of Zebulun from east to west.
passages.sermon:
Gad is one of the tribes of Israel.
Gad will receive one portion of land.
This portion will border the territory of Zebulun.
The border will run from the east side to the west side.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל זְבוּלֻ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־ פְּאַת־ יָ֖מָּה גָּ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: The southern border of Gad will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt and out to the Great Sea.
passages.sermon:
Gad is a tribe of Israel.
Gad will have a southern border.
This border will start at Tamar.
The border will go to the waters of Meribath-kadesh.
The border will continue along the Brook of Egypt.
The border will reach the Great Sea.
passages.original: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל גָּ֔ד אֶל־ פְּאַ֖ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִתָּמָ֗ר מֵ֚י מְרִיבַ֣ת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה עַל־ הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions,” declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He declares His will.
He gives land to the tribes of Israel.
This land is their inheritance.
These are the portions for each tribe.
The Lord GOD assigns these portions.
passages.original: זֹ֥את הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּפִּ֥ילוּ מִֽנַּחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

passages.text: “These will be the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which will be 4,500 cubits long, the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. On the north side there will be three gates: the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi.
passages.sermon:
The city will have exits.
The north side of the city will be 4,500 cubits long.
The city will have gates named after the tribes of Israel.
There will be three gates on the north side.
One gate will be named Reuben.
One gate will be named Judah.
One gate will be named Levi.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה תּוֹצְאֹ֣ת הָעִ֑יר מִפְּאַ֣ת צָפ֔וֹן חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים מִדָּֽה׃ וְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֗יר עַל־ שְׁמוֹת֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁעָרִ֥ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה שַׁ֣עַר רְאוּבֵ֞ן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יְהוּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר לֵוִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: On the east side, which will be 4,500 cubits long, there will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin, and the gate of Dan.
passages.sermon:
The city has four sides.
The east side is one of these sides.
The east side will be 4,500 cubits long.
There will be three gates on the east side.
One gate will be named after Joseph.
One gate will be named after Benjamin.
One gate will be named after Dan.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ פְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ימָה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וְשַׁ֨עַר יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר דָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: On the south side, which will be 4,500 cubits long, there will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun.
passages.sermon:
The city has four sides.
The south side is one of these sides.
The south side will be 4,500 cubits long.
There will be three gates on the south side.
One gate will be named after Simeon.
One gate will be named after Issachar.
One gate will be named after Zebulun.
passages.original: וּפְאַת־ נֶ֗גְבָּה חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֜וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מִדָּ֔ה וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר שִׁמְע֞וֹן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יִשָּׂשכָר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר זְבוּלֻ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: And on the west side, which will be 4,500 cubits long, there will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher, and the gate of Naphtali.
passages.sermon:
The west side of the city will be 4,500 cubits long.
This side will have three gates.
One gate will be the gate of Gad.
One gate will be the gate of Asher.
One gate will be the gate of Naphtali.
passages.original: פְּאַת־ יָ֗מָּה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים שַֽׁעֲרֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר גָּ֞ד אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר אָשֵׁר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר נַפְתָּלִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: The perimeter of the city will be 18,000 cubits, and from that day on the name of the city will be: THE LORD IS THERE.”
passages.sermon: The city will have a perimeter of 18,000 cubits.\r\nFrom that day, people will call the city by a new name.\r\nThe new name will be "The Lord is There."
passages.original: סָבִ֕יב שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וְשֵׁם־ הָעִ֥יר מִיּ֖וֹם יְהוָ֥ה׀ שָֽׁמָּה׃
